outerRunner.meaning: The read suite passed against the frozen candidate. The outer runner retained FAIL for shared host manifest drift; this archive does not relabel that result.

dataset.origin: 24,000 representative inserted rows plus eight controlled fixture rows. Original log supplies total/tenant/ceiling values; tenant active and ceiling scan rows are also visible in the preserved actual plans.

correspondence.projection: Representative page SQL mirrors production reads.rs RECORDS projection, including both UTC to_char timestamps.
correspondence.ordering: Production ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC.
correspondence.parameters: Typed tenant/organization/owner/search bindings correspond to the production scope and query components. The original logger parameters object is retained; ordered bindings are additionally reconstructed from the frozen fixture.
correspondence.scope: Representative tenant + deleted_at + organization ceiling / owner components; not every possible grant scope or filter combination.
correspondence.export: Representative production capacity CTE limits selected rows to 1001 and computes count plus minimum textual byte cost.

limitations: Representative SQL aligned with production projection, ordering, parameter types and scope components; not a byte-for-byte SQL capture of each HTTP request.
Single controlled PostgreSQL fixture observations, not production latency, throughput, cold-cache behavior, a production SLA, or statistical performance estimates.
Eight plans do not cover all grant shapes, organization-list cardinalities, filters, tenant sizes or data distributions.
Buffers are recorded per original plan node; the table uses root execution buffers and planning buffers separately, never sums nested hits. Missing planning buffer output remains null.
The read suite result and outer runner result are separate; this archive does not certify whole-phase completion.

indexDecision.reason: No new index was added in Phase 17. Preserve these measured baseline plans and existing work_orders_tenant_org_active / work_orders_tenant_owner_active indexes; this sample does not establish a universal index recommendation.
